title: Another Contraction in China's Dry Bulk Imports
section_path: Another Contraction in China's Dry Bulk Imports
section_path_text: Another Contraction in China's Dry Bulk Imports
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
As we discussed in Commodore Research's most recent Weekly China Report, coal, iron ore, and soybean imports in October collectively totaled 152.5 million tons. This is down by 12.6 million tons (-8%) from September and down year-on-year by 10 million tons (-6%). Imports have now contracted on a year-on-year basis for two straight months.
